# Hazeltree appoints Trafelet as CEO

  
 04 August 2026 US   
 Reporter: Theodore Law

Generic business image for news article
Image: Hazeltree [...] Prior to this, Trafelet served as managing partner at global hedge fund Trafelet Delta Funds and private investment firm Trafelet & Company, alongside a tenure as senior advisor to the US Department of the Interior.   
   
 Alongside this appointment, Hazeltree has selected Jessica Segarra as the firm’s chief operating officer and Martin Koopman as chief product officer.  
   
 Segarra previously served as the global head of operations at Schoenfeld Strategic Advisors Management and as deputy head of operations at Balyasny Asset Management.  
   
 Koopman operated as chief product officer and co-head of AI at Broadridge, and before that as Broadridge’s head of strategy and product innovation. [...] Hazeltree has appointed the company’s executive chairman, Remy W. Trafelet, as chairman, president, and CEO, along with two additional senior leadership appointments.  
   
 Trafelet will succeed Lokesh Seth, marking the next phase of the company's growth, expanding its treasury management, as well as its networked data and AI capabilities for alternative asset managers.  
   
 Trafelet founded Hazeltree within his alternative asset management firm, Trafelet Delta Funds, prior to spinning the company out in 2011.  
   
 He returned to the role of executive chairman in late 2024, renewing strategic focus on Hazeltree's treasury value proposition and data networking solutions.

# Hazeltree Names Founder Remy W. Trafelet CEO, Expands Executive Leadership Team

Hazeltree has appointed founder and Executive Chairman Remy W. Trafelet as Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer, marking a leadership transition as the treasury management and financial data technology provider sharpens its focus on serving alternative asset managers. Trafelet succeeds Lokesh Seth, whose contributions during his tenure were acknowledged by the company. [...] Headquartered with global operations in New York, London and Hong Kong, Hazeltree provides treasury management and financial data solutions to hedge funds, private equity firms, pension and endowment funds, and traditional asset managers, with a platform designed to improve treasury operations and operational efficiency across institutional investment organizations.

Koopman joins from Broadridge, where he served as Chief Product Officer and Co-Head of AI, following an earlier role leading strategy and product innovation. During his tenure, he oversaw the company’s global product organization, helping shape enterprise product strategy, platform integration and artificial intelligence initiatives.

Trafelet said Segarra’s experience as both a former Hazeltree client and an executive in alternative asset management brings valuable operational insight for the company’s customers, while Koopman’s background in product strategy and AI development will support continued enhancements to Hazeltree’s technology platform for hedge fund and private equity clients.

# Our Company

Over 500 sophisticated investment management firms across the globe – with over $4T in client assets – rely on Hazeltree’s innovative cloud-based treasury and liquidity solutions. Purpose-built for investment management and private markets firms, our solutions facilitate almost $8 billion in transactions across over 10,000 funds every day, delivering enhanced transparency, liquidity, and risk mitigation. Our clients increase returns and gain tangible business value by optimizing counterparty interactions, credit facilities, margin requirements, fees, and more.
